answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 5341 Country: United Kingdom Title: I have named my daughter as Malaika, I wanted to know if its islamically premitted or not? Question: I have named my daughter as Malaika, I wanted to know if its islamically premitted or not? Answer ID: 5341 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 85/85=M) In Arabic 'Malaika' means common angels, some of them have proper nouns, but no angel is named as 'Malaika'. Though naming one's daughter 'Malaika' is not unlawful, but it is not better. You are advised to keep any other name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
